Dates now come out zero-padded (`2026-03-05`, not `2026-3-5`) in all three places: the report header, the CSV export, and the payment reminder subject.

**What changed**

- **`report.js`, `export.js`, `email.js`**: each now calls `isoDate` instead of building the string by hand, so the format lives in one place.
- **`test/dates.test.js`** (new): covers the helper plus each of the three call sites, including a single-digit month and day.

I left the existing `test/report.test.js` as it was. It was the test that was failing before the fix, and it now passes.

The project isn't a git repo, so I didn't commit anything.
